dedupe_keys.name: geo sv rostock de drinking water datasets

description: geo.sv.rostock.de: drinking water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.sv.rostock.de. Coverage: the area served by geo.sv.rostock.de. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drinking water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Trinkwasserspender in der Hanse- und Universitätsstadt Rostock; Trinkwassernotbrunnen in der Hanse- und Universitätsstadt Rostock. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-zero). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
